initial_info.info1: Specify the database, select the target column, and enter your OPENAI API KEY to evaluate the database!
initial_info.info2: If you're hesitant to share your OpenAI key, feel free to check out the code for this project (link below).
initial_info.info3: The model used internally is the gpt-5-nano, which is currently the cheapest of all (July 2026).
initial_info.info4: The cost of evaluating the database depends on the size of the database and the parameters you define.

sidebar.file_upload_help: CSV file, comma separated up to 10MB
sidebar.target_col_placeholder: Choose the target column for the ML task
sidebar.eval_agent_max_its_help: This doesn't limit, necessarily, the amount of called tools. Generally, this may be way lower than the transformation agent's iterations
sidebar.transform_agent_max_its_help: This doesn't limit, necessarily, the amount of called tools
sidebar.advanced_options_info: Options to avoid an eternal agent loop
sidebar.eval_agent_max_supersteps_help: If the agent's supersteps surpass this number, an exception will be raised. Increase this value if the agent isn't generating the evaluation.
sidebar.transform_agent_max_supersteps_help: If the agent's supersteps surpass this number, an exception will be raised. Increase this value if the agent isn't generating the transformation.
